reports.title: Water accumulation near Sector 4 Market entrance
reports.description: Heavy water logging has accumulated right outside the main market entrance. Water level is around 8-10 inches and stagnant, making pedestrian access impossible.

reports.title: Main stormwater drain blocked near Sector 4 Market
reports.description: The municipal storm sewer culvert opposite Gate 2 is completely clogged with discarded plastic packaging and silt. Water is backflowing onto the carriageway.

reports.title: Road flooded outside State Bank branch Sector 4
reports.description: Arterial road surface is submerged under knee-deep water. At least two compact hatchbacks have stalled in the middle of the flooded road trying to cross.

reports.title: Severe traffic disruption and gridlock on Market Road
reports.description: Vehicles cannot pass due to deep standing water and blocked drainage culvert. Traffic backup extends over 1.2 kilometers toward the main roundabout.

reports.title: Heavy tree branch snapped onto high tension powerline
reports.description: A large banyan tree branch broke during early morning winds and is hanging directly across the 11kV electrical distribution wires on West Boulevard.

reports.title: Continuous electrical sparking from transformer pole
reports.description: The overhead transformer pole next to the fallen branch is sparking violently with loud buzzing sounds. Immediate electrocution risk to pedestrians.

reports.title: Entire stretch of streetlights dark on West Boulevard
reports.description: Following the transformer sparks, all 16 sodium streetlamps along the 500m avenue have gone completely dark, creating dangerous night driving conditions.

reports.title: Dangerous deep crater pothole on Expressway Ramp
reports.description: Pothole measuring approximately 4 feet wide and 6 inches deep on the expressway descent. Vehicles are swerving abruptly to avoid damage.

reports.title: Motorcycle slipped on broken road surface near Industrial Gate
reports.description: Loose gravel and broken asphalt from the large pothole caused a two-wheeler to skid. The rider suffered minor abrasions. Urgent patch work needed.

reports.title: Commercial garbage dumpster overflowing into pedestrian lane
reports.description: The municipal bin has not been cleared for 4 days. Waste is spilling over 20 meters down the lane, producing an unbearable foul smell and attracting stray animals.

reports.title: Uncollected plastic debris obstructing stormwater inlet near School
reports.description: Bags of household refuse dumped directly on top of the rainwater intake grate outside City Public School. Rain predicted tomorrow.
reports.locationName: School Road, Near City Public School

reports.title: Damaged pedestrian bridge railing over drainage canal
reports.description: A 4-meter section of the iron safety railing has rusted through and collapsed into the canal. Severe fall hazard for school children and night pedestrians.

reports.title: Industrial diesel generator exceeding permitted decibels at night
reports.description: Heavy construction generator operating continuously past 11:30 PM exceeding residential noise standards. Vibrations felt in adjacent apartments.

reports.title: Stagnant water and heavy mosquito breeding in open basement pit
reports.description: Abandoned commercial construction basement has 3 feet of green stagnant water. Nearby residents report high incidence of viral fever.

incidents.title: Potential Incident: Concentrated Drainage Failure & Road Flooding at Sector 4 Market
incidents.description: Algorithmic correlation identified 4 distinct community reports submitted within a 150m perimeter within 90 minutes. Stagnant stormwater and blocked storm culverts have induced arterial road submergence and gridlock on Market Road.
evidence: 4 correlated observations reported within a 150m perimeter in under 1.5 hours
Cascade relationship: Clogged storm culvert (REP-002) directly causing road flooding (REP-003) and traffic gridlock (REP-004)
High physical hazard: Stalled vehicles reported submerged; pedestrian access blocked
Historical recurrence: Sector 4 identified as repeat low-lying drainage choke point
incidents.reviewNotes: Confirmed road flooding. Urgent pump trucks dispatched.

incidents.title: West Boulevard Fallen Tree Branch & Electrical Sparking Hazard
incidents.description: Severe storm damage caused heavy branch collapse across 11kV distribution line, triggering transformer sparking and consecutive blackout of 16 streetlights.
incidents.reviewNotes: Confirmed by Municipal Control Room. Emergency electrical team dispatched to de-energize feeder line and clear branch.
evidence: 3 community reports documenting electrical hazard, active sparks, and blackout
Emergency verification: Live 11kV wire contact confirmed

incidents.title: North Industrial Expressway Ramp Pothole Hazard & Surface Restoration
incidents.description: Deep road depression and loose asphalt on industrial transit arterial causing vehicle damage and two-wheeler skidding risk.
incidents.resolutionNotes: Rapid asphalt cold mix compaction completed. 4m x 2m section resurfaced and leveled. Traffic signage restored.
evidence: 2 reports of vehicle damage and skid on high-speed expressway ramp
Work order WO-2026-449 executed with cold mix asphalt
